items.claim: transformRunTexts goes quadratic when a case mapping changes length
joiningRuns treats Cf characters that ArabicShaping.txt lists as U as transparent
layoutCanvasRuns fakes small caps for a face that has its own `smcp` glyphs
markdownToRuns reads an unpaired delimiter as a toggle, eating it and styling the rest
items.note: This was a behavior call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`. Now a marker that nothing closes is read as text. `runsToMarkdown` now closes every flag it opens; `fittedMarkdown` only moves through flag sets it can spell closed. Before, it left closings that would misread unwritten. The coverage floor for "consumed" input in `runs.grammar.pbt.test.ts` drops from 50 to 12, because random input now mostly reads as literal text.

items.claim: A backslash delimiter is accepted, but the escape handling eats it
items.note: This was a strict call, recorded in `docs/unruled.md`: `markersByDelimiter` now throws for `\`.
